title: Prediction issue on OpenAI models via Replicate

timeline.body: Cloudflare is aware of, and investigating, an issue affecting predictions on official OpenAI models via Replicate. Customers may see that some predictions are failing with a 401 token_invalidated error. We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified
